name: Transparent retry must rebuild the semantic owner set

payload.description: A failed attempt may discover an implicit mutation/check owner set that changes after a concurrent commit; retry must derive the set from the successful attempt, not union it with stale work.
payload.highest_value_matrix: Make attempt 1 owner set larger than attempt 2. A stale delete/cascade/check is then visible as durable loss or constraint violation.
admission_gates: prove a real storage conflict and ExecRetryCount > 0
change the semantic owner set, not only owner values
compare with the legal serialized control
check base rows, physical indexes, and semantic constraints
payload.negative_screen: A same-owner replay only proves idempotency and is weaker than an owner-set delta.

provenance.source: FK cascade owner-set delta retry matrix

name: Pause before Txn.Commit and create a real TiKV conflict

steps: enable a request-scoped pause immediately before session calls Txn.Commit
start one autocommit DML and wait until it is paused
disable the pause before running the blocker
commit a second session mutation on a key in the writer's read/write owner set
resume writer and require its SQL to finish
assert ExecRetryCount is at least one and inspect retry logs
compare final durable state with a serial no-retry control
payload.fault_altitude: after SQL execution and mutation construction, before client-go prewrite/commit
payload.toolchain_gate: Direct go test leaves failpoint.Inject markers disabled unless failpoint source rewriting ran. The probe must expose a hit witness; a direct failpoint.Eval hook is a test-only fallback.
payload.invalid: No pause witness, no conflicting committed key, or ExecRetryCount=0.

provenance.source: TiDB session pre-commit probe plus real TiKV write conflict

name: Test-only TiDB session pause before Txn.Commit

payload.why_needed: A direct repository go test does not rewrite failpoint.Inject markers, so an enabled marker can silently be a no-op.
payload.required_cleanup: Disable the failpoint before the blocker executes; otherwise the process-wide pause also delays the blocker.

payload.red: Final state contains any mutation owned only by the failed attempt, omits work owned by the successful attempt, violates FK closure, fails ADMIN CHECK, or differs from every legal serial order.
payload.green: ExecRetryCount > 0; final rows equal the intended serial order; FK anti-joins are empty; ADMIN CHECK and forced index/record scans agree.
payload.strongest_cell: Attempt 1 cascades child/grandchild deletion; blocker moves child to another parent; attempt 2 must shrink the cascade set and preserve child plus grandchild.

name: Autocommit retry drops the stale FK cascade set

payload.source_shape: The first autocommit DELETE builds a recursive parent-child-grandchild cascade; a real commit conflict causes transparent transaction replay after a concurrent child-owner change.
matrix: same-set control: blocker only updates parent and replay repeats the cascade
changed-set probe: blocker moves child from deleted parent 1 to surviving parent 2, so replay must preserve child and grandchild
payload.observed: Both runs retried on real TiKV. The changed-set result exactly matched move-child-then-delete-parent serialization; no stale delete leaked.
payload.holding_guard: Transaction replay rebuilds executor/FK trigger work on a fresh transaction; attempt-local cascade mutations do not survive into the successful attempt.
payload.reopen_only_if: a different implicit work producer stores owner identity outside transaction reset/rebuild and the successful attempt consumes it

provenance.source: TiDB master 94b834d FK cascade retry matrix

name: FK cascade retry must use only the successful attempt owner set

payload.p_check: A real TiKV conflict discards the first autocommit transaction and re-enters the DELETE statement.
payload.q_claim: Recursive FK cascade owners are rebuilt from the retry's current rows and relationships.
payload.f_effect: Unioning old cascade work can delete a child/grandchild that a concurrent transaction legally moved to a surviving parent.
payload.result: GREEN: stale cascade owner set was dropped and full FK/index closure held.

title: Failed autocommit attempt might leak stale FK cascade deletes into retry

payload.do_not_repeat: Do not enumerate cascade depth or timing. Reopen on a different implicit producer or a retained owner cache outside transaction rebuild.

rationale: The schedule creates a true storage-level replay boundary after attempt-local work exists.
The test-only pause exposes a deterministic window for a committed conflicting owner change.
The changed-set durable result detects stale deletes that same-set idempotency cannot.
FK cascades are rebuilt under current transaction replay; move to a different implicit work owner.

evidence.retry: ExecRetryCount >= 1 and retry log names the DELETE
evidence.oracle: control/probe exact rows equal; FK anti-joins empty; ADMIN CHECK and index closure pass

lessons.value: Confirms the probe reaches real retry, but same-set replay is weaker than an owner-set delta.

evidence.oracle: moved child and grandchild survive; deleted parent absent; all FK/index closure checks pass

lessons.guard: The first attempt's cascade mutation set is discarded before retry rebuild.
lessons.selector_refinement: Future candidates must name an implicit owner cache outside transaction reset/rebuild.
lessons.matrix_lesson: Change set membership, not only values, to expose stale attempt work.
